name: Other running processes
plain: Blocked: apps cannot list what else is running.
meaning: The foreground app list reveals habits. Android narrowed process lists from 5.0; a Usage Access special permission is the only broad proxy.

android.note: Usage Access gives per-app foreground time, not a process list

limits.headline: Can't list the other apps running on your phone
limits.user_action: Nothing. It is blocked by the phone itself
can: See how long each app was in front, if you switched on Usage access on Android
cannot: List other running apps on iPhone
List other running apps on Android 5 and later
Learn which app is open without the Usage access switch
limits.reach_label: Blocked, apart from Usage access on Android
limits.differs: iPhone hides it fully. Android 5 and later removed the list, but a Usage access switch shows per app foreground time.

story.what_it_is: Blocked: an app cannot see which other apps are running on your phone.
story.for_you: You do not notice anything. Apps simply cannot spy on what you are doing in other apps in the background.
story.for_makers: Makers once used the running app list to measure rivals and tune ads. Android shut it down in version 5, so the only broad stand-in is the special Usage access permission.

use_cases.example: A game wanted to know if you had a rival game open to send a 'come back' push. It cannot.
An antivirus app can no longer list every process, so it checks apps by install instead.
A tracker wanted to learn which video app you used right before an ad. The OS now blocks that view.
A task manager app cannot kill other apps, so it can only suggest closing them.
A battery saver shows only apps that have used energy through the system's own reports.
A parental control app needs Usage access and a special accessibility link to see what a child is running.

story.android_note: Android removed process lists in version 5.0 and now exposes only the app's own processes.
story.ios_note: iOS has never shown other running apps.

technical_bounds: Usage Access is the only proxy

history.change: getRunningTasks limited to the caller's own tasks
